description: Have the agent perform ONE verifiable outcome in the session's browser and verify it, e.g. "create a customer named {{runid}} and confirm it appears in the list". One verifiable outcome per do: split multi-part tasks into several calls. State expected values in the sentence. Credentials: write each secret as one {{env:NAME}} marker ({{totp:NAME}} for a one-time code), exactly as written: the marker alone, never the value and never $NAME. NAME must be set in the environment the MCP server was started with. Never ask the user for a secret value. Needs a model API key in the server environment. Returns the report (status, summary, evidence values). Exit 1 = the agent could not complete it.

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

instruction.description: The outcome to achieve and how to verify it (sent on stdin, so any text is safe).

session.description: Browser session name (default "default"). Each session is its own browser and daemon.

name: do
